title: WARD Tip
description: A ward tip/checkpoint (v0.2). Summarizes chain state at a point in time with optional Ed25519 signing. See SPEC.md section 8.

tip_seq.description: The sequence number of the entry being checkpointed

tip_chain_hash.description: chain_hash of the entry at tip_seq

entry_count.description: Number of entries in the chain up to and including tip_seq

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC Z suffix — when the tip was created

sig.description: Ed25519 signature over tip_chain_hash hex bytes (base64-encoded, optional but SHOULD be present)

key_id.description: Stable identifier for the signing key (DID or fingerprint)

sink_ref.description: Reference to external sink where this tip was published (e.g., Gitea tag URL, S3 object key)
